from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0045.png").convert("RGB"))
# Sofa armrest on right side of obs_0045:
# u > 400, v in 300..450
sofa_mask = (abs(img[:, :, 0].astype(int) - img[:, :, 1].astype(int)) < 15) & \
            (abs(img[:, :, 1].astype(int) - img[:, :, 2].astype(int)) < 15) & \
            (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 0] < 150)
pts = np.argwhere(sofa_mask)
print(f"Sofa pixels in obs_0045: {len(pts)}")
if len(pts) > 0:
    print(f"u range: [{pts[:, 1].min()}, {pts[:, 1].max()}]")
    print(f"v range: [{pts[:, 0].min()}, {pts[:, 0].max()}]")
    # find contact with floor (highest v in sofa region)
    max_v = pts[:, 0].max()
    print("max v:", max_v, "at u:", pts[pts[:, 0] == max_v, 1].mean())
'
